name: phase8_detection_levers
split: eval/heldout_v1 (frozen in 44cd5cf); decisions use the TEST split only
criteria: Each arm is compared with the baseline on the TEST split by the first criterion that differs, in this order (same as split.json decision_rules):
2. false alerts on the normal-swimming clip - fewer wins
3. all false alerts on test - fewer wins
4. median time-to-alert over events detected by BOTH - lower by >= 0.5 s wins
5. victim ID changes at the labelled victim keyframes - fewer wins
tie: A tie on every criterion is NOT a win: the lever stays OFF.
several_winners: If more than one arm wins, the winners are compared with each other by the same criteria and only the best is switched on; combinations are not tested in Phase 8.
cost: Per-frame latency (p50) and the admitted camera count are reported for every arm; they do not decide, but a winner that admits 0 cameras at 10 fps on the dev GPU is reported as not deployable and stays OFF.
dev_split: Dev numbers are not run for every arm (cost); they are run for a winner only, for diagnosis, and never decide.
